labels.description: The self-insurance risk factor now describes the catastrophic coverage as "third-party insurance coverage" and rephrases "the occurrence of significant claims" as "the incurrence of losses from significant claims"; the list of self-insured categories and the adverse-impact language are unchanged.
labels.rationale: Minor: the edits are stylistic rewording with identical meaning (catastrophic coverage above self-insurance levels was already insurance from outside carriers) plus a stray "Table of Contents" page artifact, with no new risk, event, severity change or number.

labels.description: The legal proceedings risk factor now says involvement in proceedings could "impact the brand and reputation of the Company" instead of "impact the reputation of the Company"; everything else is identical.
labels.rationale: Minor: adding "brand" beside "reputation" is stylistic rewording of the same reputational harm, with no new proceeding, exposure, likelihood or severity change, or quantitative change.
